name: Button
description: Primary action button. Matches Figma "Button — v2" component set (node 10715:35477). No Context axis — light/dark theming flows from the S2A variable modes (:root[data-theme]); knockout and outline-inverse are the styles for always-dark media surfaces.

props.name: label
props.description: Button label text (Figma Label text prop)

props.name: state
props.description: Forced visual state for docs; interactive states come from CSS pseudo-classes

props.name: showIconStart
props.description: Show leading icon (Figma Show Icon Start)

props.name: showIconEnd
props.description: Show trailing icon (Figma Show Icon End; defaults to caret)

props.name: iconStart
props.description: Leading icon content (Figma Icon Start instance swap)

props.name: iconEnd
props.description: Trailing icon content (Figma Icon End instance swap)

legacyPropMapping.description: v1 props are still accepted and mapped for older call sites: intent=accent → style=accent; background=solid+context=on-dark → style=knockout; background=outlined+context=on-dark → style=outline-inverse; background otherwise maps to the same-named style. The context prop itself no longer exists — page theme comes from :root[data-theme].

tokenBindings.focus-ring: --s2a-color-focus-ring-default; knockout/outline-inverse use --s2a-color-focus-ring-knockout with a --s2a-color-background-knockout gap ring

knownTokenGaps: All v2 button token names (s2a/color/button/{background,content,border}/{style}/{state}) are bound in Figma but not yet in the shipped tokens release — CSS chains each to a shipped var with identical light/dark resolution and upgrades automatically when they ship.

outline-inverse hover/active resolve white/08–16 in Light but black/08–24 in Dark in Figma; no shipped var flips that direction, so the invariant white fallbacks are used until the v2 tokens ship (visually subtle: 8–16% overlays on media surfaces).
md height 40px and vertical padding 14px are unbound in Figma with no matching semantic tokens.

notes: Disabled <a> buttons get aria-disabled='true', tabindex='-1', and a click interceptor.
Focus ring is a two-layer box-shadow using --s2a-color-focus-ring-default (or -knockout on media styles).
Icon spans are aria-hidden; the label text carries the accessible name.
